_comment: Drop this into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Mac) or %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). Restart Claude Desktop. For BYOL (unlimited), uncomment the second block.

doxa_byol_example._comment: Rename to 'doxa' (and remove the anon block above) to enable BYOL with your own Anthropic key. Free anon is rate-limited to 50/day per IP; BYOL has no Doxa-side limit.
